exampleSentences: The page token hides the internal sort key from clients.
Opaque page tokens keep the server free to change the query.
A missing token means there are no further pages.
Tokens can embed a snapshot time for consistent paging.

defCn: 无限滚动：滚动到底部时自动加载下一页的界面模式
defEn: A user interface pattern that loads the next page when the user scrolls near the bottom.
exampleSentence: Infinite scroll feels smooth but breaks the back button history.
exampleSentences: Infinite scroll feels smooth but breaks the back button history.
Attach the page token to the scroll state for deep links.
Infinite scroll loads fewer records than an explicit pager.
Offer a pagination fallback for accessibility.

defCn: 过滤：按条件缩小查询结果集合的操作
defEn: Narrowing a result set by applying conditions to the query.
exampleSentence: Filtering lets the client ask for exactly the rows it needs.
exampleSentences: Filtering lets the client ask for exactly the rows it needs.
Allowlist the filter fields the API understands.
Combining many filters may need a composite index.
Return the applied filters in the response metadata.

defCn: 排序：按指定字段对结果集排列顺序
defEn: Ordering a result set by one or more named fields.
exampleSentence: Sorting should always have a deterministic tie breaker.
exampleSentences: Sorting should always have a deterministic tie breaker.
A leading minus sign usually means descending order.
Sorting on an unindexed column can be very expensive.
Return the applied sort in the response metadata.

defCn: 每页大小：单次请求返回的记录条数
defEn: The number of records a single page of results contains.
exampleSentence: Cap the page size on the server to protect the database.
exampleSentences: Cap the page size on the server to protect the database.
Clients may request a smaller page size than the maximum.
A large page size means more memory and slower first byte.
Return the effective page size when you clamp it.

defCn: 总条数：满足条件的记录总数
defEn: The total number of records matching the query, not just the current page.
exampleSentence: Returning the total count can be expensive on huge tables.
exampleSentences: Returning the total count can be expensive on huge tables.
Counting every row slows down the whole query.
Offer an approximate count for large result sets.
Some clients need the total count to render a pager.

defCn: 下一页：分页结果中指向后续数据块的引用
defEn: The reference in a paginated result that points to the following block of data.
exampleSentence: Expose the next page as a link so clients can follow it blindly.
exampleSentences: Expose the next page as a link so clients can follow it blindly.
A missing next page field means the last page was reached.
Following links keeps the client free of pagination logic.
Encode the next page as an opaque token.

defCn: 是否还有更多：分页响应中表示结果未完的布尔标记
defEn: A boolean flag in a paginated response saying whether more records exist.
exampleSentence: The has more flag avoids an extra counting query.
exampleSentences: The has more flag avoids an extra counting query.
Fetch one extra record to learn whether more exist.
A has more flag is cheaper than a total count.
Clients should stop paging when the flag turns false.

defCn: 重试等待提示：响应头告知客户端多久后可再次请求
defEn: The header telling the client how long to wait before repeating the request.
exampleSentence: Send Retry-After with a 429 so clients back off politely.
exampleSentences: Send Retry-After with a 429 so clients back off politely.
The value is either a delay in seconds or an HTTP date.
Well behaved clients honour the retry after hint.
Omitting the header invites a retry storm.

defCn: 认证质询头：401 响应中说明可用认证方案
defEn: The header in a 401 response that lists the supported authentication schemes.
exampleSentence: The WWW-Authenticate header tells the client how to authenticate next.
exampleSentences: The WWW-Authenticate header tells the client how to authenticate next.
Browsers show a login dialog when they see Basic.
A bearer challenge can carry error details.
Always include it in a 401 response.

defCn: 请求标识头：贯穿一次调用链的唯一追踪标识
defEn: A header carrying a unique identifier that follows one call through the whole chain.
exampleSentence: The X-Request-ID header lets support find the exact request in the logs.
exampleSentences: The X-Request-ID header lets support find the exact request in the logs.
Propagate the X-Request-ID across every service hop.
Accept a client supplied id only after sanitising it.
Echo it back in the response so users can quote it.

defCn: 限流上限响应头：告知调用方窗口内允许的最大请求数
defEn: The response header telling the caller the maximum requests allowed in the window.
exampleSentence: The X-RateLimit-Limit header lets a client plan its request rate.
exampleSentences: The X-RateLimit-Limit header lets a client plan its request rate.
Publish the limit window together with the limit value.
Clients should pace themselves using the advertised limit.
The header is informational, not a contract.

defCn: 剩余配额响应头：告知当前窗口内还剩多少次请求
defEn: The response header telling the caller how many requests remain in the current window.
exampleSentence: The X-RateLimit-Remaining header helps clients slow down before hitting the wall.
exampleSentences: The X-RateLimit-Remaining header helps clients slow down before hitting the wall.
A low remaining value warns the client to back off.
The value resets when the window rolls over.
It is often easier to read than the retry after header.

defCn: 限流重置响应头：告知限流窗口何时重新开始计算
defEn: The response header telling when the rate limit window resets.
exampleSentence: The X-RateLimit-Reset header marks the end of the current window.
exampleSentences: The X-RateLimit-Reset header marks the end of the current window.
The value is a unix timestamp in seconds.
Clients can sleep until the reset moment.
Show the reset time in the dashboard for the customer.

defCn: 标准化限流响应头：新一代统一格式的限流信息头
defEn: The standardised header that reports rate limit policy in a structured format.
exampleSentence: The RateLimit header is the modern replacement for the X-RateLimit family.
exampleSentences: The RateLimit header is the modern replacement for the X-RateLimit family.
It can describe several policies at once.
The reset time is included in the same header.
Adopt it if you want a future proof client contract.

defCn: 转发来源头：记录请求经过的代理链与原始客户端地址
defEn: The header listing the proxy chain and the original client address.
exampleSentence: Read the last but one entry of X-Forwarded-For to find the real client.
exampleSentences: Read the last but one entry of X-Forwarded-For to find the real client.
Only trusted proxies may set this header.
The leftmost entry is the original client address.
Rate limiting per client depends on this header.

defCn: 标准转发头：以结构化方式记录代理链与原始请求信息
defEn: The standardised header that records proxy chain information in a structured form.
exampleSentence: The Forwarded header is the standard alternative to X-Forwarded-For.
exampleSentences: The Forwarded header is the standard alternative to X-Forwarded-For.
Each proxy appends one element to the list.
The original scheme and host are preserved.
Some older proxies only understand the X- headers.

defCn: 范围请求：客户端只请求资源某一段字节的部分请求
defEn: A request that asks for only a byte range of a larger resource.
exampleSentence: A range request lets a player resume an interrupted download.
exampleSentences: A range request lets a player resume an interrupted download.
The server answers with 206 and a content range header.
Large media files benefit from range request support.
Reject a range header that overlaps a locked chunk.

defCn: Link 头：在响应中附带分页或关联资源链接的头
defEn: The header that carries links to related resources, such as the next page.
exampleSentence: The Link header is a clean way to expose pagination links.
exampleSentences: The Link header is a clean way to expose pagination links.
Clients follow rel=next without understanding the query format.
Multiple links are separated by commas.
It fits well with a hypermedia style API.

defCn: 弃用提示头：告知该接口即将废弃及其替代方案
defEn: The header announcing that an endpoint is deprecated and what replaces it.
exampleSentence: The Deprecation header gives clients time to migrate.
exampleSentences: The Deprecation header gives clients time to migrate.
Pair it with a sunset date so removal is predictable.
Log the header value to measure adoption of the new version.
Removing a deprecated endpoint still needs a version bump.

defCn: 停用日期头：声明该接口将被下线的具体日期
defEn: The header that states the date when the endpoint will be switched off.
exampleSentence: The Sunset header tells partners exactly when to move.
exampleSentences: The Sunset header tells partners exactly when to move.
Announce the sunset date as soon as you decide it.
Combine it with the deprecation header for clarity.
Track who still calls the endpoint near the sunset date.

defCn: 可接受编码头：客户端声明能解码的压缩方式
defEn: The request header listing the content encodings the client can decode.
exampleSentence: The server picks the best encoding the client accepts.
exampleSentences: The server picks the best encoding the client accepts.
Always include gzip in the accepted encodings.
Brotli usually compresses text better than gzip.
The response should also set the Vary header.

defCn: 可接受语言头：客户端声明偏好的界面语言
defEn: The request header listing the languages the client prefers.
exampleSentence: The Accept-Language header drives localisation of the response.
exampleSentences: The Accept-Language header drives localisation of the response.
Quality factors order the preferences.
Always send the Vary header with a localised response.
Fall back to a default language when nothing matches.

defCn: 内容语言头：声明主体内容所使用的自然语言
defEn: The header naming the natural language used in the body content.
exampleSentence: The Content-Language header describes the body, not the headers.
exampleSentences: The Content-Language header describes the body, not the headers.
It is different from the Accept-Language request header.
A response may list several content languages.
Search engines use it to target the right locale.

defCn: 内容处置头：指示浏览器如何处理返回的内容
defEn: The header telling the client how to treat the returned content.
exampleSentence: The Content-Disposition header makes a response download as a file.
exampleSentences: The Content-Disposition header makes a response download as a file.
Use inline for documents the browser should display.
Quote the filename to survive spaces and unicode.
Sanitise any filename that comes from user input.

defCn: 部分更新：只修改资源中被显式指定字段的操作
defEn: An update that changes only the fields explicitly named in the request.
exampleSentence: A partial update leaves untouched fields exactly as they were.
exampleSentences: A partial update leaves untouched fields exactly as they were.
Define how null values are treated in a partial update.
Partial updates need optimistic locking to avoid lost writes.
Return the full updated resource for clarity.

defCn: 版本请求头：通过头部指定所请求的 API 版本
defEn: A request header that selects which version of the API the client wants.
exampleSentence: The API version header keeps the URL free of version segments.
exampleSentences: The API version header keeps the URL free of version segments.
Header based versioning keeps every URL identical.
The default version should be the oldest supported one.
Document the header in the API documentation.

defCn: 请求体上限：服务端允许接收的最大请求体字节数
defEn: The maximum number of bytes a server accepts in a request body.
exampleSentence: Set a request body size limit on every public endpoint.
exampleSentences: Set a request body size limit on every public endpoint.
Exceeding the limit should return a 413.
Reverse proxies need a matching limit.
Large uploads should use a dedicated flow.

defCn: 头部大小上限：允许请求头占用的最大字节数
defEn: The maximum number of bytes allowed in the request header block.
exampleSentence: A header size limit blocks oversized header abuse.
exampleSentences: A header size limit blocks oversized header abuse.
Oversized headers cause a 431 response.
Some tokens are large enough to hit the limit.
Keep the limit aligned across proxies and services.

defCn: 方法覆盖：在代理限制下用 POST 携带真实方法的机制
defEn: A mechanism that carries the intended method inside a POST request when proxies block others.
exampleSentence: HTTP method override is a compatibility hack, not a design.
exampleSentences: HTTP method override is a compatibility hack, not a design.
Only enable it for trusted clients.
Log overridden methods so you can remove the hack later.
Some frameworks disable the header by default.

defCn: 条件请求：附带条件头、只在条件满足时返回完整内容的请求
defEn: A request carrying a condition so the server only returns a full body when the condition holds.
exampleSentence: A conditional request saves bandwidth on unchanged resources.
exampleSentences: A conditional request saves bandwidth on unchanged resources.
The server answers 304 when the condition does not hold.
Conditional requests pair well with ETags and Last-Modified.
Caches use them on every revalidation.

defCn: 头部注入：把换行等字符写入头部以伪造额外头部的攻击
defEn: An attack that injects line breaks into a header value to forge extra headers.
exampleSentence: Header injection is blocked by validating every header value.
exampleSentences: Header injection is blocked by validating every header value.
Never echo raw user input into a response header.
Modern frameworks reject newlines in header values.
Strip control characters from redirect targets.

defCn: 跨域策略：决定哪些来源与请求方式被允许的规则集合
defEn: The set of rules that decides which origins, methods and headers may call the API.
exampleSentence: A strict CORS policy keeps other websites away from your API.
exampleSentences: A strict CORS policy keeps other websites away from your API.
Define the policy once in configuration and reuse it.
Allow credentialed requests only for known origins.
Test the policy in the browser, not with curl.

defCn: 限流窗口：统计请求次数所使用的时间区间
defEn: The time interval over which the request counter for a rate limit is measured.
exampleSentence: A one minute window is the most common choice for public APIs.
exampleSentences: A one minute window is the most common choice for public APIs.
A fixed window can allow a burst across the boundary.
A sliding window smooths that edge effect.
Publish the window together with the limit.

defCn: 令牌桶：按速率补充令牌、允许突发请求的限流算法
defEn: A rate limiting algorithm that refills tokens at a fixed rate and spends one per request.
exampleSentence: The token bucket algorithm allows controlled bursts.
exampleSentences: The token bucket algorithm allows controlled bursts.
Capacity sets the largest burst the client can trigger.
A token bucket needs shared storage to work across nodes.
It is the basis of many HTTP rate limiters.

defCn: 漏桶：以固定速率排空请求的限流算法
defEn: A rate limiting algorithm that queues requests and releases them at a constant rate.
exampleSentence: A leaky bucket smooths traffic into a steady stream.
exampleSentences: A leaky bucket smooths traffic into a steady stream.
It caps the average rate exactly.
Queued requests wait when the bucket is full.
Pair it with a timeout so requests do not queue forever.

defCn: 拦截器，在请求进入业务处理前后插入横切逻辑的组件。
defEn: A component that inserts cross-cutting logic before and after request handling.
exampleSentence: The interceptor stamped the correlation id onto every inbound request.
exampleSentences: The interceptor stamped the correlation id onto every inbound request.
We added an interceptor so audit logging lives in one place.
An interceptor can short-circuit the request before the controller runs.

defCn: 过滤器，在 Servlet 容器层对请求与响应做处理的组件。
defEn: A component that processes requests and responses at the servlet container level.
exampleSentence: The filter compressed the response before it left the container.
exampleSentences: The filter compressed the response before it left the container.
The auth filter rejects requests that carry no valid token.
Filters run once per request, unlike interceptors that wrap the handler.

defCn: 处理器，最终执行某个请求业务逻辑的单元。
defEn: The unit that finally executes the business logic for a request.
codeExample: public class OrderHandler { public void handle(Order o) { } }
exampleSentence: The handler delegated the billing rules to a dedicated service.
exampleSentences: The handler delegated the billing rules to a dedicated service.
Each route maps to exactly one handler in the registry.
Keep the handler thin so the domain logic stays testable.

defCn: 服务层，封装业务用例并编排领域对象与仓储的层。
defEn: The layer that encapsulates business use cases and orchestrates domain objects and repositories.
codeExample: public class OrderService { public Order place(Order o) { ... } }
exampleSentence: The service layer owns the transaction boundary for each use case.
exampleSentences: The service layer owns the transaction boundary for each use case.
Controllers stay thin because the service layer holds the real rules.
Never let a controller talk to the repository directly.

defCn: 仓储，封装持久化细节并向上层返回领域对象的抽象。
defEn: An abstraction that hides persistence details and returns domain objects to callers.
codeExample: public interface OrderRepository { Optional<Order> findById(String id); }
exampleSentence: The repository returned an empty optional instead of null.
exampleSentences: The repository returned an empty optional instead of null.
Swapping the database means replacing the repository implementation only.
A repository speaks in domain terms, not in rows and columns.

defCn: 数据访问对象，直接面向数据表进行 CRUD 的持久化组件。
defEn: A persistence component that performs CRUD operations directly against data tables.
exampleSentence: The DAO maps one to one onto the user table columns.
exampleSentences: The DAO maps one to one onto the user table columns.
We kept the DAO thin and put the rules in the service layer.
A DAO is table-shaped, while a repository is domain-shaped.

defCn: 数据传输对象，专门用于跨层或跨服务传递数据的简单对象。
defEn: A simple object shaped purely for carrying data across layers or services.
codeExample: public record OrderDTO(String id, long total) { }
exampleSentence: The DTO keeps the internal entity out of the API contract.
exampleSentences: The DTO keeps the internal entity out of the API contract.
We added a DTO so the domain model could evolve freely.
Never return a database entity directly from a public endpoint.

defCn: 实体，具有唯一标识并在其生命周期内保持同一性的领域对象。
defEn: A domain object with an identity that stays the same across its whole lifecycle.
exampleSentence: The entity is matched by id, not by its field values.
exampleSentences: The entity is matched by id, not by its field values.
Two entities with the same fields are still different entities.
JPA entities need a no-arg constructor and non-final fields.

defCn: 映射器，负责在两种模型之间转换的组件。
defEn: A component that converts between two different models.
exampleSentence: The mapper keeps the DTO shape out of the domain model.
exampleSentences: The mapper keeps the DTO shape out of the domain model.
We hand-wrote the mapper so the conversion stayed explicit.
A mapper keeps entity-to-DTO conversion out of the service layer.

defCn: 控制反转，把对象的创建与依赖装配交给容器管理的设计思想。
defEn: The design idea of handing object creation and dependency wiring to a container.
exampleSentence: IoC let the service receive its collaborator instead of building it.
exampleSentences: IoC let the service receive its collaborator instead of building it.
With IoC the business code no longer knows how to construct its dependencies.
IoC is the foundation the DI container implements.

defCn: 服务，对外暴露业务能力的组件。
defEn: A component that exposes a business capability to other layers.
codeExample: public interface PaymentService { Receipt charge(long amount); }
exampleSentence: The service owns the business rules and the transaction boundary.
exampleSentences: The service owns the business rules and the transaction boundary.
Call the service, not the repository, from the controller.
A service should be stateless so it can be scaled horizontally.

defCn: 服务发现，通过注册与查询机制动态获取服务实例地址的方案。
defEn: A mechanism where services register their addresses and callers look them up dynamically.
exampleSentence: Service discovery removed the hard-coded host list from the config file.
exampleSentences: Service discovery removed the hard-coded host list from the config file.
The instance list refreshes automatically as pods come and go.
Consul and Kubernetes DNS both provide service discovery.

defCn: 面向前端的后端层，为特定前端聚合裁剪接口的独立服务。
defEn: A dedicated backend layer that aggregates and trims APIs for one frontend.
exampleSentence: The BFF returned one payload instead of six chatty calls.
exampleSentences: The BFF returned one payload instead of six chatty calls.
A BFF per frontend keeps the mobile app small and fast.
Do not let a BFF contain business rules.

defCn: 退避，在重试之间逐步拉长等待时间的策略。
defEn: A strategy that lengthens the wait between successive retries.
exampleSentence: The backoff stopped the retry storm from saturating the downstream service.
exampleSentences: The backoff stopped the retry storm from saturating the downstream service.
We added jitter to the backoff so clients did not retry in lockstep.
Always combine backoff with a cap and jitter.

defCn: 发件箱，与业务写入同一事务的消息表，保证事件不丢失。
defEn: A message table written in the same transaction as the business data so events are never lost.
exampleSentence: The outbox pattern removed the gap between the commit and the publish.
exampleSentences: The outbox pattern removed the gap between the commit and the publish.
A relay process reads the outbox and forwards the rows to the broker.
The outbox gives you at-least-once delivery without a distributed transaction.

defCn: 消费者，订阅并处理消息的组件。
defEn: A component that subscribes to and processes messages.
exampleSentence: The consumer acknowledged the message only after the write succeeded.
exampleSentences: The consumer acknowledged the message only after the write succeeded.
Scaling the consumer count past the partition count buys nothing.
A consumer must be idempotent because redelivery is normal.

defCn: 生产者，向消息通道发布消息的组件。
defEn: A component that publishes messages onto a messaging channel.
exampleSentence: The producer published the event inside the business transaction.
exampleSentences: The producer published the event inside the business transaction.
The producer should not care who consumes the message.
A producer that waits for a broker ack adds latency but improves durability.

defCn: 消息代理，负责接收、存储与分发消息的中间件。
defEn: Middleware that receives, stores, and routes messages between producers and consumers.
exampleSentence: The broker redelivered the message after the consumer crashed.
exampleSentences: The broker redelivered the message after the consumer crashed.
The broker keeps the offset so the consumer can resume where it stopped.
A broker decouples the producer from the consumer's availability.

defCn: 死信队列，存放无法处理或超过重试次数消息的隔离队列。
defEn: An isolated queue that holds messages that cannot be processed or exhausted their retries.
exampleSentence: The poison messages landed in the DLQ instead of blocking the partition.
exampleSentences: The poison messages landed in the DLQ instead of blocking the partition.
We replay the DLQ after fixing the downstream bug.
A DLQ must be monitored, otherwise failures hide there.

defCn: 缓存层，位于应用与数据源之间以降低访问开销的组件层。
defEn: A layer between the application and the data source that reduces access cost.
exampleSentence: The caching layer absorbed the repeated lookups on the hot path.
exampleSentences: The caching layer absorbed the repeated lookups on the hot path.
Every cached read should be cheaper than the miss that follows it.
Put the caching layer behind an interface so it can be swapped.

defCn: 旁路缓存，由应用自行决定何时读缓存、何时回源。
defEn: A caching pattern where the application itself decides when to read the cache and when to fall back.
codeExample:
val = cache.get(k);
if (val == null) { val = db.load(k); cache.set(k, val); }
exampleSentence: The cache-aside pattern keeps the database logic in the service layer.
exampleSentences: The cache-aside pattern keeps the database logic in the service layer.
A short lock on the miss path avoids a cache stampede.
Cache-aside needs invalidation logic; the cache never expires data by itself.

defCn: 写穿透，写入数据源的同时同步更新缓存的策略。
defEn: A strategy that updates the cache in the same step as the data source write.
exampleSentence: Write-through removed the window where the cache served stale data.
exampleSentences: Write-through removed the window where the cache served stale data.
The write path costs one extra cache round trip.
Use it when stale reads are unacceptable.

defCn: 缓存失效，写入后主动清除或更新缓存中旧值的动作。
defEn: The act of clearing or refreshing stale cache entries after a write.
exampleSentence: Cache invalidation right after the write kept the read path honest.
exampleSentences: Cache invalidation right after the write kept the read path honest.
Forgetting invalidation is the classic cause of a stale-read bug.
Delete on write is simpler and safer than updating in place.

defCn: 后台任务，不阻塞请求线程而在后台执行的作业。
defEn: A job that runs in the background instead of blocking the request thread.
exampleSentence: The report moved to a background job so the request stayed fast.
exampleSentences: The report moved to a background job so the request stayed fast.
A background job needs its own retry and alerting.
Keep background jobs idempotent, because they get retried.

defCn: 调度器，按计划触发任务执行的组件。
defEn: A component that triggers job execution according to a schedule.
exampleSentence: The scheduler skipped the run while the service was in maintenance mode.
exampleSentences: The scheduler skipped the run while the service was in maintenance mode.
Clustered schedulers need a lock so a job runs once, not n times.
A scheduler decides when; the worker decides how.

defCn: Cron 表达式，描述任务触发时间规则的配置字符串。
defEn: A configuration string that describes when a scheduled job should fire.
exampleSentence: The cron expression ran the sweep every five minutes.
exampleSentences: The cron expression ran the sweep every five minutes.
The cron expression lives in config so the schedule changes without a rebuild.
Remember that the scheduler uses the JVM time zone by default.

defCn: 任务队列，存放待执行作业并分发到工作进程的队列。
defEn: A queue that holds pending jobs and hands them to worker processes.
exampleSentence: The task queue absorbed the burst while the workers caught up.
exampleSentences: The task queue absorbed the burst while the workers caught up.
A task queue decouples the request from the slow work it triggers.
Size the queue so a burst does not become an outage.

defCn: 工作进程，从任务队列领取并执行作业的进程。
defEn: A process that pulls jobs off the task queue and executes them.
exampleSentence: Each worker took one job at a time so the slow ones did not pile up.
exampleSentences: Each worker took one job at a time so the slow ones did not pile up.
Workers should be stateless so they can be replaced freely.
A worker that dies mid-job must leave the queue recoverable.

defCn: 优雅停机，停止接收新请求并等待在途请求处理完再退出的过程。
defEn: The process of refusing new work, draining in-flight requests, and only then exiting.
exampleSentence: The graceful shutdown finished the last upload before the pod exited.
exampleSentences: The graceful shutdown finished the last upload before the pod exited.
The deployment must send SIGTERM for the drain to start.
Set a drain timeout so a stuck request cannot block the shutdown forever.

defCn: 存活探针，判断进程是否还活着、是否需要被重启的检查。
defEn: A probe that decides whether the process is still alive and needs restarting.
exampleSentence: The liveness probe stayed green while the readiness probe was red.
exampleSentences: The liveness probe stayed green while the readiness probe was red.
Keep the liveness check free of external dependencies.
A liveness failure means the orchestrator should restart the pod.

defCn: 就绪探针，判断实例能否开始接收流量的检查。
defEn: A probe that decides whether the instance can start taking real traffic.
exampleSentence: The readiness probe kept the new pod out of the load balancer until it was warm.
exampleSentences: The readiness probe kept the new pod out of the load balancer until it was warm.
Readiness may check dependencies, unlike liveness.
Turning readiness off during a slow warm-up causes dropped requests.

defCn: 指标，以数值形式连续记录系统运行状况的遥测数据。
defEn: Telemetry data that records how the system is behaving as numbers over time.
exampleSentence: The metrics showed the latency spike started right after the deploy.
exampleSentences: The metrics showed the latency spike started right after the deploy.
Track the four golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, and saturation.
Metric names must be stable, because dashboards depend on them.

defCn: 日志，记录系统运行事件与诊断信息的输出。
defEn: The output that records system events and diagnostic information.
exampleSentence: The logging statement carried the order id so we could trace the flow.
exampleSentences: The logging statement carried the order id so we could trace the flow.
Use structured logs so a log platform can index the fields.
Never log secrets, tokens, or personal data.

defCn: 分布式追踪，跨服务跟踪一次请求完整调用链的机制。
defEn: A mechanism that follows one request across service boundaries.
exampleSentence: The distributed tracing view showed the database call as the slow hop.
exampleSentences: The distributed tracing view showed the database call as the slow hop.
A trace context has to cross every process boundary to be useful.
Sampling keeps the trace volume affordable.

defCn: 关联标识，在一次请求的全部日志与调用中保持不变的唯一标记。
defEn: A unique marker that stays the same across every log line and hop of one request.
exampleSentence: The correlation ID let us pull the whole request out of the log store.
exampleSentences: The correlation ID let us pull the whole request out of the log store.
Propagate the correlation ID in a request header.
Without it, tracing a single request across services is guesswork.

defCn: 服务等级目标，对服务可靠性水平的量化承诺。
defEn: A quantified commitment to the reliability level of a service.
exampleSentence: The SLO gave the team a clear line between acceptable and unacceptable.
exampleSentences: The SLO gave the team a clear line between acceptable and unacceptable.
An SLO should be measurable from the user's point of view.
SLA is the contractual promise; the SLO is the internal target.

defCn: 错误预算，允许失败的剩余额度，由 SLO 反推得出。
defEn: The remaining allowance for failure, derived from the SLO.
exampleSentence: The error budget was still healthy, so we shipped the risky change.
exampleSentences: The error budget was still healthy, so we shipped the risky change.
Spending the budget freezes features until reliability recovers.
The error budget makes the reliability trade-off a shared decision.

defCn: 部署，把应用版本发布到运行环境的动作。
defEn: The act of releasing an application version into a running environment.
exampleSentence: The deployment finished in under a minute thanks to the rolling update.
exampleSentences: The deployment finished in under a minute thanks to the rolling update.
A deployment should be scripted and repeatable, never manual.
Separate deployment from release so you can control the traffic switch.

defCn: 滚动更新，逐批替换实例以保持服务连续的发布方式。
defEn: A release strategy that replaces instances in batches to keep the service available.
exampleSentence: The rolling update swapped every pod without dropping a request.
exampleSentences: The rolling update swapped every pod without dropping a request.
Set maxUnavailable to zero when the service must stay fully online.
The old and new versions run side by side for a while.

defCn: 金丝雀发布，先让少量实例承接新版本流量的发布方式。
defEn: A release strategy that routes a small share of traffic to the new version first.
exampleSentence: The canary caught the error-rate regression before the full rollout.
exampleSentences: The canary caught the error-rate regression before the full rollout.
Compare the canary metrics against the baseline, not against nothing.
The canary percentage grows only while the metrics stay healthy.

defCn: 蓝绿发布，两套环境并存并整体切换流量的发布方式。
defEn: A release strategy that keeps two environments and switches traffic between them.
exampleSentence: The blue-green switch was instant and the rollback was too.
exampleSentences: The blue-green switch was instant and the rollback was too.
It doubles infrastructure cost, so it suits critical services.
The database schema must tolerate both versions during the switch.

defCn: 特性开关，通过运行时开关控制功能是否生效的机制。
defEn: A runtime switch that controls whether a feature is active.
exampleSentence: The feature flag let us ship the code dark and enable it later.
exampleSentences: The feature flag let us ship the code dark and enable it later.
Every flag needs an owner and a removal date.
A flag that never gets cleaned up becomes a permanent branch in the code.

defCn: 基础设施即代码，用声明式文件描述并版本化管理基础设施。
defEn: Managing infrastructure through declarative files kept under version control.
exampleSentence: The infrastructure as code change went through a normal code review.
exampleSentences: The infrastructure as code change went through a normal code review.
The state file made the infrastructure reproducible.
Manual console changes are the main source of drift.

defCn: 配置，控制应用行为但不属于代码的可变参数集合。
defEn: The mutable set of parameters that controls application behaviour.
exampleSentence: The config held the feature switch so no rebuild was needed.
exampleSentences: The config held the feature switch so no rebuild was needed.
Keep config separate from code so the same build runs everywhere.
Config is a deployable artifact, so treat it with the same care.

defCn: 机密，敏感的配置值，如口令、密钥与证书私钥。
defEn: Sensitive configuration values such as passwords, keys, and private certificates.
exampleSentence: The secrets came from the vault instead of the config file.
exampleSentences: The secrets came from the vault instead of the config file.
Never commit secrets to the repository.
Rotate secrets on a schedule and after every incident.

defCn: 环境变量，由操作系统进程环境提供的外部配置项。
defEn: An external configuration value provided through the process environment.
exampleSentence: The environment variable held the database URL for the container.
exampleSentences: The environment variable held the database URL for the container.
Environment variables fit containers, where a config file is awkward.
Read them once at startup into a typed config object.

defCn: 容器化，把应用与其依赖打包成可移植运行单元的做法。
defEn: Packaging an application with its dependencies into a portable runtime unit.
exampleSentence: The containerization made the same image run on every environment.
exampleSentences: The containerization made the same image run on every environment.
Keep the image minimal and the layer order stable for caching.
A container is not a security boundary by default.

defCn: 编排，管理容器调度、扩缩容与健康恢复的自动化层。
defEn: The automation layer that schedules containers, scales them, and recovers them.
exampleSentence: The orchestration restarted the crashed pod before anyone noticed.
exampleSentences: The orchestration restarted the crashed pod before anyone noticed.
The orchestrator reconciles the declared state with the actual state.
Declarative manifests are what make it work.

defCn: 横向扩容，增加实例数量以提升整体处理能力。
defEn: Adding more instances to increase the overall processing capacity.
exampleSentence: The horizontal scaling absorbed the seasonal traffic spike.
exampleSentences: The horizontal scaling absorbed the seasonal traffic spike.
Horizontal scaling needs the application to be stateless.
Session affinity is the usual obstacle to horizontal scaling.

defCn: 纵向扩容，提升单个实例的资源规格以提升处理能力。
defEn: Increasing the resource size of a single instance to raise its capacity.
exampleSentence: The vertical scaling was the quickest fix for a memory-hungry job.
exampleSentences: The vertical scaling was the quickest fix for a memory-hungry job.
It has a hard ceiling and it needs a restart.
Prefer horizontal scaling for stateless services.

defCn: 会话亲和，把同一用户的请求固定路由到同一实例的机制。
defEn: A mechanism that routes all requests of one user to the same instance.
exampleSentence: The session affinity kept the in-memory shopping cart working.
exampleSentences: The session affinity kept the in-memory shopping cart working.
It works around a design problem instead of fixing it.
It blocks smooth autoscaling and rolling updates.

defCn: 数据库连接，应用程序与数据库之间的通信会话。
defEn: A communication session between the application and the database.
exampleSentence: The database connection was returned to the pool right after the transaction.
exampleSentences: The database connection was returned to the pool right after the transaction.
A leaked connection starves the whole pool.
Acquisition time matters as much as execution time when you profile.

defCn: 事务边界，一次原子操作所覆盖的代码范围。
defEn: The extent of code that a single atomic operation covers.
codeExample:
@Transactional
public void transfer(Account a, Account b) { ... }
exampleSentence: The transaction boundary ended at the service method, not the controller.
exampleSentences: The transaction boundary ended at the service method, not the controller.
A boundary inside a loop multiplies the round trips.
Keep the boundary in one place so retries stay safe.

defCn: 工作单元，把一组持久化变更聚合并一次性提交的边界。
defEn: A boundary that groups a set of persistence changes into one commit.
exampleSentence: The unit of work flushed every change in a single transaction.
exampleSentences: The unit of work flushed every change in a single transaction.
It keeps the flush count low on batch jobs.
A unit of work per request is a common default.

defCn: 迁移，对数据库结构或数据做演进式修改的过程。
defEn: The process of evolving a database schema or its data in a controlled way.
codeExample: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN channel varchar(32);
exampleSentence: The migration ran before the new code was rolled out.
exampleSentences: The migration ran before the new code was rolled out.
Migrations should be backward compatible with the running version.
Always ship expand and contract as two separate steps.

defCn: 种子数据，环境初始化时写入的基准记录。
defEn: Baseline records written into an environment when it is initialised.
exampleSentence: The seed data gave the new environment its default roles.
exampleSentences: The seed data gave the new environment its default roles.
Seed data must be idempotent so it can be replayed safely.
Keep it small; real reference data belongs in migrations.

defCn: 软删除，标记记录为已删除但保留数据的删除方式。
defEn: A deletion approach that marks the record as deleted while keeping the data.
exampleSentence: The soft delete kept the historical order for the audit trail.
exampleSentences: The soft delete kept the historical order for the audit trail.
Every query has to filter the deleted rows explicitly.
A unique constraint must ignore soft-deleted rows too.

defCn: 审计轨迹，记录系统内关键操作的不可篡改历史。
defEn: An immutable history of the significant operations performed in a system.
exampleSentence: The audit trail showed who changed the payout account and when.
exampleSentences: The audit trail showed who changed the payout account and when.
Write audit records to a separate store so they survive a rollback.
Audit data has retention rules of its own.

defCn: 多租户，单个系统实例同时服务多个相互隔离的客户。
defEn: Serving multiple isolated customers from a single system instance.
exampleSentence: The multi-tenancy model shared the code but isolated the data.
exampleSentences: The multi-tenancy model shared the code but isolated the data.
A missing tenant filter leaks one customer's data into another's report.
Shared schema is cheapest, shared nothing is safest.

defCn: 租户隔离，保证一个租户的数据绝不会被另一个租户访问的机制。
defEn: A mechanism guaranteeing that one tenant's data is never reachable from another.
exampleSentence: The tenant isolation was enforced in the repository layer, not per query.
exampleSentences: The tenant isolation was enforced in the repository layer, not per query.
Test isolation explicitly; a leak is a cross-customer incident.
Row-level security in the database is the strongest backstop.

defCn: 备份，对数据做可恢复副本的过程与产物。
defEn: The process and artifact of creating a restorable copy of your data.
exampleSentence: The nightly backup gave us a restore point after the corruption.
exampleSentences: The nightly backup gave us a restore point after the corruption.
A backup that was never restored is only a hope.
Store backups off the primary host and encrypt them.

defCn: 恢复，把备份数据重新装载回运行系统的过程。
defEn: The process of loading backup data back into a live system.
exampleSentence: The restore rehearsal took forty minutes, which was the whole point.
exampleSentences: The restore rehearsal took forty minutes, which was the whole point.
A restore you have never timed is a restore you cannot plan for.
Restore into an isolated environment first.

defCn: 灾难恢复，在严重故障后把系统恢复到可运行状态的完整方案。
defEn: The complete plan for bringing the system back to a working state after a severe failure.
exampleSentence: The disaster recovery plan named the exact steps for a region loss.
exampleSentences: The disaster recovery plan named the exact steps for a region loss.
The plan has to be written for a tired engineer at three in the morning.
Regular drills are the only way the plan stays real.

defCn: 基础设施层，负责与外部系统交互的最底层实现。
defEn: The lowest layer that implements the interaction with external systems.
exampleSentence: The infrastructure layer held every SQL statement in the system.
exampleSentences: The infrastructure layer held every SQL statement in the system.
Business rules must not depend on this layer.
Swapping the database touches only this layer.

defCn: 领域层，包含业务实体与领域规则的核心层。
defEn: The core layer that holds the business entities and the domain rules.
exampleSentence: The domain layer expressed the money rule and rejected the naive case.
exampleSentences: The domain layer expressed the money rule and rejected the naive case.
This layer has no framework dependency at all.
Keep it the most stable layer in the codebase.

defCn: 六边形架构，把核心业务与外部适配器用端口连接的架构风格。
defEn: An architectural style that connects the core domain to external adapters through ports.
codeExample: public interface PaymentPort { Receipt charge(Money m); }
exampleSentence: The hexagonal architecture let us swap the payment provider without touching the domain.
exampleSentences: The hexagonal architecture let us swap the payment provider without touching the domain.
Ports belong to the inside, adapters to the outside.
The dependency arrow always points inward.

defCn: 命令查询分离，把写操作与读操作分成不同模型的模式。
defEn: A pattern that separates write models from read models.
exampleSentence: The command query separation kept the write path strict and the read path flexible.
exampleSentences: The command query separation kept the write path strict and the read path flexible.
A command changes state and returns nothing meaningful.
A query reads state and never changes it.

defCn: 事件驱动架构，组件之间通过发布与订阅事件协作的架构风格。
defEn: An architectural style where components collaborate by publishing and subscribing to events.
exampleSentence: The event-driven architecture let the notification service ship without touching the order service.
exampleSentences: The event-driven architecture let the notification service ship without touching the order service.
Events are the public contract, so they need version discipline.
Subscribe to facts, not to commands.

defCn: Saga 模式，把分布式事务拆成一串本地事务并配以补偿动作。
defEn: A pattern that splits a distributed transaction into local transactions with compensating actions.
exampleSentence: The saga pattern kept the payment and the shipment steps consistent.
exampleSentences: The saga pattern kept the payment and the shipment steps consistent.
Every step needs a well-defined compensation.
A saga is not atomic, so the states must be visible to the user.

defCn: 补偿事务，为撤销已完成的业务步骤而执行的逆向操作。
defEn: A reverse operation that undoes a business step that already completed.
exampleSentence: The compensating transaction released the reserved stock after the cancellation.
exampleSentences: The compensating transaction released the reserved stock after the cancellation.
Compensation is a new business action, not a database rollback.
It must be idempotent, because it may run twice.

defCn: 幂等消费者，重复收到同一消息也只产生一次业务效果的消费者。
defEn: A consumer that produces the same business effect even when the same message arrives twice.
exampleSentence: The idempotent consumer survived a broker redelivery without double-charging.
exampleSentences: The idempotent consumer survived a broker redelivery without double-charging.
Deduplicate on a business key, not only on the message id.
Store the processed key with the business write in one transaction.

defCn: 消息顺序保证，同一业务键的消息按产生顺序被消费的能力。
defEn: The guarantee that messages for one business key are consumed in the order they were produced.
exampleSentence: The message ordering guarantee let the consumer apply state transitions sequentially.
exampleSentences: The message ordering guarantee let the consumer apply state transitions sequentially.
Ordering usually only holds within a partition.
More partitions mean more parallelism and less ordering.

defCn: 分区键，决定消息落到哪个分区并据此维持顺序的键。
defEn: The key that decides which partition a message lands in and thereby keeps ordering.
exampleSentence: The partition key was the order id, so all events for one order stayed ordered.
exampleSentences: The partition key was the order id, so all events for one order stayed ordered.
A skewed key creates a hot partition.
Choose a key with high cardinality and even distribution.

defCn: 消费者组，一组共同分担分区并协同消费同一主题的消费者。
defEn: A set of consumers that share the partitions of a topic and process it together.
exampleSentence: The consumer group scaled to six workers and split the partitions between them.
exampleSentences: The consumer group scaled to six workers and split the partitions between them.
Consumers in one group never see the same message.
Different groups are independent consumers of the same topic.

defCn: 消费者位点，标记某个消费组已处理到哪条消息的进度。
defEn: The position marking how far a consumer group has progressed through the log.
exampleSentence: The consumer offset was committed only after the business write succeeded.
exampleSentences: The consumer offset was committed only after the business write succeeded.
Committing before the write loses messages on a crash.
Rebalancing resets the offset assignment, not the stored progress.

defCn: 分区重平衡，消费者增减后重新分配分区所有权的过程。
defEn: The process of reassigning partition ownership after consumers join or leave.
exampleSentence: The partition rebalancing briefly paused consumption while it ran.
exampleSentences: The partition rebalancing briefly paused consumption while it ran.
The rebalance storm hurt latency, so we raised the session timeout.
Static membership reduces needless rebalances.

defCn: 发布确认，broker 确认已持久化消息的机制。
defEn: A broker acknowledgement that a message has been durably written.
exampleSentence: The publisher confirms turned a silent write failure into a visible error.
exampleSentences: The publisher confirms turned a silent write failure into a visible error.
Waiting for confirms costs latency but buys durability.
acks=all is the safe default for important topics.

defCn: 法定人数，分布式系统中获得多数派确认才算成功的副本数量规则。
defEn: A rule where a majority of replicas must acknowledge before an operation counts as successful.
exampleSentence: The quorum rule kept the broker from acknowledging a write one replica could not restore.
exampleSentences: The quorum rule kept the broker from acknowledging a write one replica could not restore.
A majority quorum is the simplest defence against split brain.
Trade the extra latency for the consistency guarantee.

defCn: 读修复，在读取时用最新值修复副本不一致的机制。
defEn: A mechanism that repairs divergent replicas with the freshest value during a read.
exampleSentence: The read repair fixed the stale replica the first time the key was read.
exampleSentences: The read repair fixed the stale replica the first time the key was read.
It only converges for keys that are actually read.
Anti-entropy covers the rest.

defCn: 反熵，后台周期性比对副本以消除数据差异的过程。
defEn: A background process that periodically compares replicas to remove divergence.
exampleSentence: The anti-entropy sweep reconciled the replica that nobody read for a month.
exampleSentences: The anti-entropy sweep reconciled the replica that nobody read for a month.
It costs bandwidth, so run it when traffic is low.
Read repair is the fast path, anti-entropy is the thorough one.

defCn: Gossip 协议，节点之间随机互播以交换状态的分布式协议。
defEn: A protocol where nodes randomly exchange state to converge on a shared view.
exampleSentence: The gossip protocol spread the new membership without a central registry.
exampleSentences: The gossip protocol spread the new membership without a central registry.
It converges quickly but eventually, not instantly.
It suits large clusters where a leader would be a bottleneck.

defCn: 边车代理，与业务容器同Pod 部署并拦截出入流量的代理。
defEn: A proxy deployed alongside the application container that intercepts its traffic.
exampleSentence: The sidecar proxy handled the retry policy for the order service.
exampleSentences: The sidecar proxy handled the retry policy for the order service.
It is the unit that makes the mesh work.
The extra hop shows up in the latency budget.

defCn: 限流器，限制单位时间内请求数量的组件。
defEn: A component that caps how many requests are accepted per unit of time.
exampleSentence: The rate limiter returned 429 instead of letting the downstream collapse.
exampleSentences: The rate limiter returned 429 instead of letting the downstream collapse.
Give each caller a distinct key, not one global bucket.
A local limiter is per instance; a global one needs shared state.

defCn: 超时预算，为整条调用链分配的等待时间上限。
defEn: The upper bound on wait time allocated across an entire call chain.
exampleSentence: The timeout budget forced the inner call to give up earlier than the outer one.
exampleSentences: The timeout budget forced the inner call to give up earlier than the outer one.
The outer timeout must exceed the sum of the inner ones.
Unbounded inner calls are the classic cause of pile-ups.

defCn: 重试风暴，故障期间大量客户端同时重试导致负载放大的现象。
defEn: The amplification of load when many clients retry at once during an outage.
exampleSentence: The retry storm flattened the queue once we added exponential backoff with jitter.
exampleSentences: The retry storm flattened the queue once we added exponential backoff with jitter.
Cap the retries and share the budget across the chain.
Retries without jitter synchronise into a thundering herd.

defCn: 抖动，在重试等待时间中加入随机成分以错开请求。
defEn: A random component added to a retry delay so clients do not retry in lockstep.
exampleSentence: The jitter spread the retries across a second instead of one instant.
exampleSentences: The jitter spread the retries across a second instead of one instant.
Always add jitter to any exponential backoff.
Without it, every client retries at exactly the same moment.

defCn: 指标端点，暴露系统运行指标以供采集的 HTTP 接口。
defEn: An HTTP endpoint that exposes runtime metrics for collection.
exampleSentence: The metrics endpoint fed the Prometheus scrape job.
exampleSentences: The metrics endpoint fed the Prometheus scrape job.
Do not expose it publicly without authentication.
Keep the metric names stable so the dashboards survive.

defCn: 结构化日志，以键值形式输出便于机器解析的日志。
defEn: Logging that emits key-value fields so a log platform can index and query them.
exampleSentence: The structured logging let us filter by order id in the log store.
exampleSentences: The structured logging let us filter by order id in the log store.
Key names must be consistent across services.
Free-text messages are for humans, fields are for machines.

defCn: 日志级别，控制日志输出详略程度的分级开关。
defEn: A severity threshold that controls how much detail is logged.
exampleSentence: The log level was raised to INFO in production to save cost.
exampleSentences: The log level was raised to INFO in production to save cost.
Choose the level per package rather than globally.
Too much DEBUG logging can be its own outage.

defCn: 脱敏，在日志与追踪中遮蔽敏感字段的处理。
defEn: The practice of masking sensitive fields before they reach logs or traces.
exampleSentence: The redaction removed the card number from every log line.
exampleSentences: The redaction removed the card number from every log line.
Redact at the logging boundary, not in the business code.
Tokens in logs are a breach waiting to happen.

defCn: 采样，只保留部分请求的追踪或日志以控制成本。
defEn: Keeping only a fraction of traces or logs to bound cost.
exampleSentence: The sampling kept the trace bill down while still showing the trends.
exampleSentences: The sampling kept the trace bill down while still showing the trends.
Sample deterministically so a trace is complete or absent.
Raise the rate for errors and keep it low for successes.

defCn: 基数，时间序列标签取值的组合数量，决定指标存储成本。
defEn: The number of distinct label combinations in a metric, which drives storage cost.
exampleSentence: The cardinality exploded when the route label carried the raw path.
exampleSentences: The cardinality exploded when the route label carried the raw path.
Never put a user id or a raw URL into a label.
High cardinality is the usual cause of a metrics bill shock.

defCn: 直方图，统计观测值落入各区间的分布型指标。
defEn: A metric type that counts how many observations fall into each bucket.
exampleSentence: The histogram showed the latency distribution instead of a single average.
exampleSentences: The histogram showed the latency distribution instead of a single average.
Pick bucket boundaries that match your latency targets.
An average hides the tail that users actually feel.

defCn: 瞬时值指标，反映某一时刻状态的数值型指标。
defEn: A metric that samples the current value of something at a moment in time.
exampleSentence: The gauge showed the connection pool sitting near its limit.
exampleSentences: The gauge showed the connection pool sitting near its limit.
A gauge is a snapshot, not a counter.
Use counters for events and gauges for levels.

defCn: 累计计数器，只增不减地统计事件发生次数的指标。
defEn: A monotonically increasing metric that counts how many events occurred.
exampleSentence: The counter gave us the true order rate over the window.
exampleSentences: The counter gave us the true order rate over the window.
Counters are reset when the process restarts, so handle that in the backend.
Rate is derived from the counter, not from the gauge.

defCn: 服务器推送事件，服务器单向向浏览器流式推送数据的 HTTP 技术。
defEn: An HTTP technique where the server streams data to the browser over one direction.
exampleSentence: The SSE connection carried the progress updates to the dashboard.
exampleSentences: The SSE connection carried the progress updates to the dashboard.
SSE reconnects automatically, unlike a raw websocket.
It runs over plain HTTP, so proxies handle it easily.

defCn: 服务间认证，服务之间相互证明身份的机制。
defEn: A mechanism where services prove their identity to each other.
exampleSentence: The service-to-service auth used a short-lived signed token.
exampleSentences: The service-to-service auth used a short-lived signed token.
Identity must be verified, not just encrypted.
Rotate the signing keys and keep the audience tight.

defCn: 双向 TLS，客户端与服务端互相验证证书的加密通信方式。
defEn: Encrypted transport where both the client and the server verify certificates.
exampleSentence: The mTLS traffic inside the mesh was mutually authenticated.
exampleSentences: The mTLS traffic inside the mesh was mutually authenticated.
It needs a certificate lifecycle, not just a certificate.
Keep the trust anchors small and rotated.

defCn: 机密管理服务，集中存储并按需下发敏感凭据的系统。
defEn: A system that centrally stores sensitive credentials and delivers them on demand.
exampleSentence: The secrets manager issued short-lived credentials instead of a static password.
exampleSentences: The secrets manager issued short-lived credentials instead of a static password.
Short-lived credentials shrink the blast radius of a leak.
Audit every read of a secret.

defCn: 密钥轮换，按周期更换密钥以限制泄露影响范围的机制。
defEn: The practice of replacing keys on a schedule to bound the impact of a leak.
exampleSentence: The key rotation ran in the middle of the night with no downtime.
exampleSentences: The key rotation ran in the middle of the night with no downtime.
Rotation must work while old and new keys coexist.
Document how to rotate before you need to.

defCn: 最小权限，仅授予完成职责所必需的最小权限的原则。
defEn: The principle of granting only the minimum permissions needed to do the job.
exampleSentence: The least privilege rule meant a leaked token could only read orders.
exampleSentences: The least privilege rule meant a leaked token could only read orders.
Scope credentials per service, never share one admin key.
Start narrow and widen only with evidence.

defCn: 爆炸半径，一次故障所能影响的范围。
defEn: The extent of the system that a single failure can affect.
exampleSentence: The blast radius of the bad deploy was one pod because the rollout was staged.
exampleSentences: The blast radius of the bad deploy was one pod because the rollout was staged.
Every risky change should have a deliberately small blast radius.
Canary and feature flags both shrink it.

defCn: 金丝雀分析，对比新旧版本指标以决定是否继续发布的过程。
defEn: The comparison of new and old version metrics that decides whether to continue the rollout.
exampleSentence: The canary analysis stopped the rollout on a rising error rate.
exampleSentences: The canary analysis stopped the rollout on a rising error rate.
Compare against the baseline, not against an absolute number.
Automate the verdict so nobody has to eyeball the graph.

defCn: 渐进式交付，通过逐步扩大暴露范围来降低发布风险的方法。
defEn: A release method that reduces risk by widening the exposed population gradually.
exampleSentence: The progressive delivery plan named the rollback point for each step.
exampleSentences: The progressive delivery plan named the rollback point for each step.
It combines canary, blue-green, and feature flags.
Advance only while the metrics hold.

defCn: 影子流量，把生产流量复制给新版本但不返回其响应的测试方式。
defEn: A test technique that mirrors production traffic to a new version without using its responses.
exampleSentence: The shadow traffic surfaced a null pointer the tests never hit.
exampleSentences: The shadow traffic surfaced a null pointer the tests never hit.
Never let shadow responses reach the real client.
It is the safest way to test against real traffic shapes.

defCn: 静默发布，把新功能部署到线上但不向用户开放的方式。
defEn: A release where the new code runs in production but stays invisible to users.
exampleSentence: The dark launch let us measure the new path with no user impact.
exampleSentences: The dark launch let us measure the new path with no user impact.
The code path is exercised but not selected.
Remember to remove the flag afterwards.

defCn: 模式注册表，集中管理消息结构并做兼容性校验的组件。
defEn: A component that centrally manages message schemas and validates compatibility.
exampleSentence: The schema registry rejected the breaking change before it reached production.
exampleSentences: The schema registry rejected the breaking change before it reached production.
Backward compatibility keeps old consumers working.
Set an explicit compatibility level per topic.

defCn: 事件信封，把元数据与事件体打包在一起的标准结构。
defEn: A standard structure that wraps event metadata together with the payload.
exampleSentence: The event envelope carried the trace id so the consumer could continue the trace.
exampleSentences: The event envelope carried the trace id so the consumer could continue the trace.
The envelope should carry the id, the type, the version, and the timestamp.
Consumers should switch on the type, not on field names.

defCn: 死信处理，对进入死信队列的消息进行诊断与重放的流程。
defEn: The workflow of diagnosing and replaying messages that landed in the dead-letter queue.
exampleSentence: The dead-letter handling replayed the failed messages after the fix.
exampleSentences: The dead-letter handling replayed the failed messages after the fix.
Alert on the depth of the queue.
Replay at a controlled rate.

defCn: 变更数据捕获，读取数据库日志以同步变更流的机制。
defEn: A mechanism that reads the database log to stream out data changes.
exampleSentence: The CDC connector fed the analytics warehouse without touching the tables.
exampleSentences: The CDC connector fed the analytics warehouse without touching the tables.
CDC avoids polling and sees the committed state.
It needs the database to expose a replication slot.

defCn: 数仓同步，把业务库数据定期同步到分析仓库的过程。
defEn: The process of periodically syncing operational data into the analytics warehouse.
exampleSentence: The warehouse sync ran hourly so the dashboard lagged by at most an hour.
exampleSentences: The warehouse sync ran hourly so the dashboard lagged by at most an hour.
Keep the sync incremental.
Full reloads get expensive fast.

defCn: 联机事务处理，为短事务读写优化的数据处理范式。
defEn: A data processing paradigm optimised for short transactional reads and writes.
exampleSentence: The OLTP store handled the order path while the warehouse did the analysis.
exampleSentences: The OLTP store handled the order path while the warehouse did the analysis.
The two workloads want different indexes and different storage.
Never point an analytical query at the OLTP primary.

defCn: 联机分析处理，为复杂聚合查询优化的数据处理范式。
defEn: A data processing paradigm optimised for complex analytical aggregations.
exampleSentence: The OLAP engine answered the revenue rollup in seconds.
exampleSentences: The OLAP engine answered the revenue rollup in seconds.
Columnar storage compresses and scans far better.
It is not the place for a single-row lookup.

defCn: 垂直分表，把一个宽表按字段拆成多个表的拆分方式。
defEn: A split that separates one wide table into several tables by column.
codeExample:
orders_core(id, status, total)
orders_meta(id, notes, tags)
exampleSentence: The vertical partitioning removed the rarely read columns from the hot table.
exampleSentences: The vertical partitioning removed the rarely read columns from the hot table.
It helps when the wide columns are large or rarely queried.
It does not increase the write throughput.

defCn: 连接池中间件，在应用与数据库之间复用连接的代理层。
defEn: A proxy layer that reuses database connections between the application and the server.
exampleSentence: The connection pooler let us raise the app concurrency beyond the server's limit.
exampleSentences: The connection pooler let us raise the app concurrency beyond the server's limit.
Transaction pooling breaks session state, so be careful with temp tables.
Put it in front of the server and scale the app freely.

defCn: 隔离线程池，为某个依赖单独划分的线程资源池。
defEn: A dedicated thread pool reserved for one dependency so it cannot starve the others.
exampleSentence: The bulkhead thread pool kept the payment slowdown away from the report jobs.
exampleSentences: The bulkhead thread pool kept the payment slowdown away from the report jobs.
Size it against the downstream limit, not the CPU count.
Unbounded pools just move the queue somewhere else.

defCn: 优雅降级，在部分依赖失效时保留核心功能的应对策略。
defEn: A strategy that keeps the core working when some dependencies are unavailable.
exampleSentence: The graceful degradation kept checkout working while the recommendation service was down.
exampleSentences: The graceful degradation kept checkout working while the recommendation service was down.
Decide the fallback for every non-essential dependency.
Degrade to something simple, never to an error page.

defCn: 负载丢弃，在系统过载时主动拒绝部分请求以保护核心路径。
defEn: Shedding load by rejecting some requests when the system is overloaded.
exampleSentence: The load shedding kept the critical checkout path responsive under a stampede.
exampleSentences: The load shedding kept the critical checkout path responsive under a stampede.
It must be a deliberate 429, not a random timeout.
Shed the cheapest requests first.

defCn: 优先级队列，让高优先级任务先于普通任务被处理的队列。
defEn: A queue that serves higher priority tasks before ordinary ones.
exampleSentence: The priority queue kept the payment callbacks ahead of the marketing emails.
exampleSentences: The priority queue kept the payment callbacks ahead of the marketing emails.
A strict priority order can starve the low tier, so age the entries.
Starvation is the classic failure of priority queues.

defCn: 请求超时，调用方等待响应的最长时间上限。
defEn: The maximum time a caller waits for a response before giving up.
exampleSentence: The request timeout stopped the thread from blocking forever.
exampleSentences: The request timeout stopped the thread from blocking forever.
Connect and read timeouts should be set separately.
An unset timeout is an unbounded queue in disguise.

defCn: 缓存预热，在服务启动时预先填充热点数据。
defEn: Preloading hot data into the cache before the service takes traffic.
exampleSentence: The cache warming meant the first requests did not stampede the database.
exampleSentences: The cache warming meant the first requests did not stampede the database.
Warm it during the readiness hold, not after the pod goes live.
Only warm what you know will be hot.

defCn: 延迟写回，先写缓存再异步落盘的写入策略。
defEn: A write strategy that updates the cache first and flushes to storage asynchronously.
exampleSentence: The write-behind path absorbed the spike but risked data loss on a crash.
exampleSentences: The write-behind path absorbed the spike but risked data loss on a crash.
Only use it when losing the last few seconds is acceptable.
It trades durability for throughput.

defCn: 服务等级协议，对外承诺的服务指标与违约责任的合同条款。
defEn: The contractual commitment to service metrics and the remedy for failing them.
exampleSentence: The service level agreement set a number the customer actually cares about.
exampleSentences: The service level agreement set a number the customer actually cares about.
The SLA is a promise; the SLO is the internal target behind it.
Every SLA term must be measurable from outside the system.

defCn: 错误率，失败请求占请求总数的比例。
defEn: The proportion of failed requests among all requests.
exampleSentence: The error rate rose just before the latency did, which pointed at the database.
exampleSentences: The error rate rose just before the latency did, which pointed at the database.
Track it per route, not just overall.
The error budget gives the error rate a budget.

defCn: 饱和度，资源接近极限的程度。
defEn: How close a resource is to its limit.
exampleSentence: The saturation metric showed the CPU was the bottleneck before latency spiked.
exampleSentences: The saturation metric showed the CPU was the bottleneck before latency spiked.
Saturation leads; latency follows.
Watch queue depth and pool utilisation as saturation signals.

defCn: 服务等级指标，衡量服务水平是否达标的量化指标。
defEn: A quantitative measure of whether the service level is being met.
exampleSentence: The SLI was simple enough that anyone could read the dashboard.
exampleSentences: The SLI was simple enough that anyone could read the dashboard.
The SLI should reflect the user experience, not the internals.
One SLI per user journey is usually enough.

defCn: 操作手册，记录某类故障处理步骤的文档。
defEn: A document that lists the exact steps for handling a specific failure.
exampleSentence: The runbook was the reason the failover took six minutes and not an hour.
exampleSentences: The runbook was the reason the failover took six minutes and not an hour.
Write it while the system is healthy.
Link each runbook from its alert.

defCn: 值班轮转，团队成员轮流承担线上故障响应的机制。
defEn: A mechanism where team members take turns responding to production incidents.
exampleSentence: The on-call rotation spread the load and made the incidents fair.
exampleSentences: The on-call rotation spread the load and made the incidents fair.
Hand over the open issues explicitly at the change of shift.
A rotation needs a backup for when someone is on leave.

defCn: 复盘会议，事故后分析原因并产出改进项的会议与记录。
defEn: A review after an incident that analyses the causes and produces action items.
exampleSentence: The postmortem turned the blame into three concrete action items.
exampleSentences: The postmortem turned the blame into three concrete action items.
Blameless does not mean causeless; it means system-focused.
Assign an owner and a date to every action item.

defCn: 变更冻结，在关键时期禁止生产环境变更的制度。
defEn: A policy that blocks production changes during a critical period.
exampleSentence: The change freeze kept the year-end peak free of surprises.
exampleSentences: The change freeze kept the year-end peak free of surprises.
Plan the release before the window closes.
Emergency changes need an explicit exception.

defCn: 回滚方案，发布失败时把系统恢复到上一版本的预案。
defEn: The prepared plan for restoring the previous version when a release goes wrong.
exampleSentence: The rollback plan was rehearsed, so it took one command.
exampleSentences: The rollback plan was rehearsed, so it took one command.
Know the exact command before you need it.
A rollback is only safe if the schema change is backward compatible.

defCn: 发布策略，选择如何把新版本铺到线上的一组规则。
defEn: The set of rules that governs how a new version reaches production.
exampleSentence: The deployment strategy changed when we learned the schema was not backward compatible.
exampleSentences: The deployment strategy changed when we learned the schema was not backward compatible.
Rolling, canary, and blue-green each have different trade-offs.
It is a design decision, not a configuration detail.

defCn: 基础设施供给，按声明自动创建并配置云上资源的过程。
defEn: The process of automatically creating and configuring cloud resources from a declaration.
exampleSentence: The infrastructure provisioning took three minutes instead of a whole afternoon.
exampleSentences: The infrastructure provisioning took three minutes instead of a whole afternoon.
Keep the state file in a locked remote backend.
Never edit a resource by hand in the console.

defCn: 容器镜像，包含应用及其运行环境的不可变打包产物。
defEn: An immutable package that holds the application and its runtime environment.
exampleSentence: The container image carried a pinned base image digest.
exampleSentences: The container image carried a pinned base image digest.
Tag by digest, not by a moving tag.
An image should be reproducible from its source.

defCn: 镜像层，容器镜像中只读且可共享的文件层。
defEn: A read-only file layer inside a container image that can be shared between images.
exampleSentence: The image layer for the dependencies stayed cached between builds.
exampleSentences: The image layer for the dependencies stayed cached between builds.
Order the Dockerfile so the changing layers come last.
Each layer is a diff, so deleting a file does not shrink the image.

defCn: 镜像仓库，集中存储与分发容器镜像的服务。
defEn: A service that centrally stores and distributes container images.
exampleSentence: The container registry mirrored the images across regions.
exampleSentences: The container registry mirrored the images across regions.
Scan the images on push.
Immutable tags keep the deployment reproducible.

defCn: 服务注册表，集中保存服务实例地址与元数据的存储。
defEn: A store that centrally holds the addresses and metadata of service instances.
exampleSentence: The service discovery registry was the single source of instance truth.
exampleSentences: The service discovery registry was the single source of instance truth.
Watch the registry rather than polling it.
The registry itself needs to be highly available.

defCn: 负载均衡健康检查，负载均衡器用于剔除故障实例的探测。
defEn: The probe a load balancer uses to remove unhealthy instances from rotation.
exampleSentence: The load balancer health check was too slow, so bad instances stayed in rotation.
exampleSentences: The load balancer health check was too slow, so bad instances stayed in rotation.
Tune the threshold to the request rate.
Align the check with the readiness endpoint.

defCn: 粘性路由，按会话标识把请求固定发往同一实例的路由方式。
defEn: Routing that pins requests for one session to the same instance.
exampleSentence: The sticky routing kept the in-memory session valid.
exampleSentences: The sticky routing kept the in-memory session valid.
It hurts load balance and rolling updates.
Prefer a shared session store.

defCn: 连接排空，实例下线前停止接收新连接并等待存量连接结束的机制。
defEn: The mechanism that stops new connections and waits for existing ones before an instance leaves.
exampleSentence: The connection draining prevented the long-lived streams from breaking.
exampleSentences: The connection draining prevented the long-lived streams from breaking.
Terminate the load balancer registration first.
Give the drain a deadline and force the rest.

defCn: 资源限制，容器可使用的 CPU 与内存上限。
defEn: The upper bound on CPU and memory a container may consume.
exampleSentence: The resource limit stopped one noisy pod from starving the node.
exampleSentences: The resource limit stopped one noisy pod from starving the node.
A limit that is too tight gets you throttled or killed.
Set the request close to the limit.

defCn: CPU 节流，容器超出配额时被内核强制暂停的现象。
defEn: The forced suspension of a container that exceeds its CPU quota.
exampleSentence: The CPU throttling explained the latency spikes that looked like a network problem.
exampleSentences: The CPU throttling explained the latency spikes that looked like a network problem.
The throttled seconds are visible in the container metrics.
Set the limit above the average and above the burst.

defCn: 内存上限，容器被允许使用的最大内存量。
defEn: The maximum amount of memory a container is allowed to use.
exampleSentence: The memory limit turned a slow leak into a fast, obvious failure.
exampleSentences: The memory limit turned a slow leak into a fast, obvious failure.
An out-of-memory kill is a crash, not a graceful exit.
Watch the working set, not just the allocation.

defCn: 读写分离，把读请求与写请求分发到不同副本的架构。
defEn: An architecture that sends read queries to replicas and writes to the primary.
exampleSentence: The read/write split absorbed the reporting traffic off the primary.
exampleSentences: The read/write split absorbed the reporting traffic off the primary.
Replication lag means the reads can be stale.
Route reads that need freshness to the primary.

defCn: 故障转移，在主节点失效时把角色切换到备用节点的过程。
defEn: The process of moving the primary role to a standby when the current primary fails.
exampleSentence: The failover completed in under a minute with the automated promotion.
exampleSentences: The failover completed in under a minute with the automated promotion.
Split brain is the danger, so the promotion needs fencing.
Test the failover, not just the backup.

defCn: 混沌工程，主动在生产环境注入故障以验证系统韧性的实践。
defEn: The practice of injecting failures deliberately to verify system resilience.
exampleSentence: The chaos engineering experiment proved the circuit breaker actually opened.
exampleSentences: The chaos engineering experiment proved the circuit breaker actually opened.
Start with a small scope and a kill switch.
Every experiment needs an abort condition.

defCn: 故障注入，在指定位置人为制造错误以测试错误处理路径。
defEn: Deliberately introducing an error at a chosen point to test error handling.
exampleSentence: The fault injection revealed the missing rollback in the service layer.
exampleSentences: The fault injection revealed the missing rollback in the service layer.
Target the paths you never exercise in production.
It is the cheapest way to test a retry policy.

defCn: 契约测试，验证服务之间接口约定保持一致的测试。
defEn: A test that verifies the agreed interface between two services stays consistent.
exampleSentence: The contract test caught the field rename before the partner deployed.
exampleSentences: The contract test caught the field rename before the partner deployed.
It is the alternative to a big integration test suite.
Publish the contract from the provider side.

defCn: 集成测试夹具，用于搭建依赖环境并运行集成测试的脚手架。
defEn: The scaffolding that stands up dependencies and runs integration tests.
exampleSentence: The integration test harness started the dependencies in two seconds.
exampleSentences: The integration test harness started the dependencies in two seconds.
Use a throwaway database per run.
Keep the harness close to the production topology.

defCn: 冒烟测试，部署后快速验证核心路径可用的检查。
defEn: A quick check after a deployment that verifies the core path still works.
exampleSentence: The smoke test caught a broken configuration before the traffic arrived.
exampleSentences: The smoke test caught a broken configuration before the traffic arrived.
Keep it under a minute so it can gate every deploy.
A handful of checks beats a slow suite nobody waits for.

defCn: 第 99 百分位延迟，99% 的请求都快于这个耗时，用来衡量最差用户体验
defEn: The 99th percentile latency: 99% of requests finish faster than this value.
exampleSentence: Our p99 is 800 ms even though the average latency is only 40 ms.
exampleSentences: Our p99 is 800 ms even though the average latency is only 40 ms.
Report the p99, not the mean, or the slow requests stay invisible.
The goal is to bring p99 under 200 ms before the holiday traffic arrives.

defCn: 尾部延迟，即最慢那一小撮请求（如 p99、p99.9）的耗时
defEn: The latency of the slowest fraction of requests, usually measured at p99 or p99.9.
codeExample: // p50 = 30ms, p99 = 1.2s -> tail latency is the p99.9 the alerts fire on
exampleSentence: Users feel tail latency far more than they ever feel the average.
exampleSentences: Users feel tail latency far more than they ever feel the average.
A single GC pause can ruin tail latency while the median looks healthy.

defCn: 百分位数，把观测值按大小排序后处于某一百分比位置的数值
defEn: The value below which a given percentage of the observations fall.
exampleSentence: We track the 95th percentile so a few slow outliers cannot hide in the average.
exampleSentences: We track the 95th percentile so a few slow outliers cannot hide in the average.
A percentile is more honest than a mean when the distribution has a long tail.

defCn: 瓶颈，系统中最先限制整体吞吐或推高延迟的那个环节
defEn: The component that limits overall throughput or adds the most latency.
codeExample: // The database is the bottleneck: 90% of the 2s request is one unindexed query
exampleSentence: The database, not the API servers, is the bottleneck in this write path.
exampleSentences: The database, not the API servers, is the bottleneck in this write path.
Find the bottleneck before you add servers, or you scale the wrong thing.
Lock contention made the counter table the bottleneck for every write.

defCn: 扇出，一个请求或消息被扩散成多个下游调用
defEn: The pattern where one request or message triggers many downstream calls.
codeExample: GET /feed  ->  fan-out to 12 services, each with its own timeout
exampleSentence: A high fan-out means one user request can amplify into fifty database queries.
exampleSentences: A high fan-out means one user request can amplify into fifty database queries.
Fan-out multiplies the failure probability of every hop it touches.

defCn: 热键，访问量远超其他键的单个缓存键或分区键，会把压力集中到一个节点
defEn: A single key or partition that receives far more traffic than the others.
codeExample: cache.get("homepage:promo")  // hot key hit by every request
exampleSentence: A hot key in the cache put all the load on one shard and skewed the cluster.
exampleSentences: A hot key in the cache put all the load on one shard and skewed the cluster.
We fixed the hot key by adding a local in-process cache in front of Redis.

defCn: 服务等级协议，对外承诺的可用性或性能目标，如 99.9% 可用
defEn: Service Level Agreement: the availability or performance target promised to customers.
codeExample: SLA: 99.9% monthly availability, p99 < 300ms, credits if breached
exampleSentence: Our SLA promises 99.9% availability, which allows about 43 minutes of downtime a month.
exampleSentences: Our SLA promises 99.9% availability, which allows about 43 minutes of downtime a month.
Every SLA breach costs us service credits, so we keep an error budget.

defCn: 平均恢复时间，从故障发生到服务恢复的平均耗时
defEn: Mean Time To Recovery: the average time needed to restore service after an incident.
exampleSentence: Better dashboards cut our MTTR from two hours to twenty minutes.
exampleSentences: Better dashboards cut our MTTR from two hours to twenty minutes.
A one-command rollback does more for MTTR than any runbook.

defCn: 恢复时间目标，灾难发生后服务必须在多长时间内恢复
defEn: Recovery Time Objective: the maximum acceptable time to restore service after a disaster.
codeExample: RTO = 4h  ->  a cold backup on tape is not acceptable
exampleSentence: The business set an RTO of four hours, so we cannot rely on rebuilding from nightly backups.
exampleSentences: The business set an RTO of four hours, so we cannot rely on rebuilding from nightly backups.
A short RTO forces you to keep a warm standby running.

defCn: 恢复点目标，灾难发生时最多能容忍丢失多长时间的数据
defEn: Recovery Point Objective: the maximum data loss, measured in time, that is acceptable after a disaster.
codeExample: RPO = 5min  ->  continuous replication, not nightly dumps
exampleSentence: With an RPO of five minutes, we need continuous replication rather than nightly backups.
